original_target.title: Optimal star-discrepancy lower bound for infinite sequences
original_target.area: Uncertainty quantification and quasi-Monte Carlo integration

scope_comparison: The current v3 Dick Theorems 1.1–1.2 and Remark 1.4 concern inverse discrepancy in dimension–accuracy polynomial strips and explicitly distinguish fixed dimension. Online thinning with log^(d+1)n unnormalized upper bounds and one finite Sobol table formalization do not give the universal fixed-d infinite-sequence lower bound log^d n infinitely often.
